scope.seed_enumeration: Every positive divisor of a^2 at every full original shell, with both tags; independently compared with every raw A*B*D factorization.
scope.signed_q: Every integer from -200 through 400, plus every p+t*m0, p+t*mk, p+t*mk+1 for t=-5 through 5, separately for every seed and scale.
scope.positive_prime_returns: Every prime q from each seed prime through 501 satisfying q=1 mod 12 and its primitive return period.
scope.radix_enumeration: Every full and PCT rectangle code at each of the five seed primes.

scaled_incidence.scope: All X divisible by 6 in [1,600], all prime factors of each X^4-X^2+1, both retained scales 1 and 2, and every corresponding bounded root branch. No assertion about other inputs or universal prime coverage.

interpretation: Exact finite validation of the stated domains and maps; the standalone proofs supply the general assertions.
